CustomField.description: The Delinquency Case this commitment belongs to. Master-Detail, not Lookup: FSD 5.9.2 requires that the Case hold ALL workflow state, so a commitment must inherit the Case’s sharing and must never outlive it. Named for the target object per ARCHITECTURE.md.
